description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'CheckoutModal' for a furniture shopping app frontend. It renders a modal dialog with input fields for user information, order summary, and action buttons, managing state and interactions with an external AppStore.

classes.name: CheckoutModal
classes.description: LightningJS component class handling checkout modal UI and interactions

methods.name: focusField
methods.description: Sets the current input focus to the specified field

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the checkout modal by invoking AppStore's closeCheckout method

methods.name: place
methods.description: Submits the order if all required fields are filled, calling AppStore's placeOrder
